title: Jesus... I Planted It And Nothing's Sprouted. 🌱
topic: she planted something months ago and keeps digging to check on it, convinced quiet soil means nothing is happening

bible.text: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I planted it and nothing's sprouted. 🌱

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Months of quiet soil. I keep digging to check.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The farmer waits for early and latter rain. He doesn't dig.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So I stop checking and just keep it watered?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Water it, walk away, sleep. The rain has a schedule.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: What's under the soil is not dead. It's early.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone waiting on quiet soil. 🌱
